notes: Grid is fixed by the brief at 13x11 (explicit, given at invocation). Slag, minCost, minPd, and parFlat chosen to match the calibration table's 13x11 rows exactly, so the pressure-designer's oppRam/headStart tuning lands on a measured, trustworthy number rather than an extrapolated one.

items.rationale: Grid is the brief's explicit ask (13x11), the largest of the three sizes in the calibration table: per the craft rules it gives the dive room to breathe and runs a round or two longer than 11x9. Slag stays at 0.18, the shipped default, because slag is texture and not a difficulty lever, and the measured 13x11 rows in reference/difficulty.md are all taken at slag 0.18 -- deviating from it would put the pressure-designer's win-rate target outside the table's calibrated ground truth. minCost is 26, exactly 2 x width as the table's baseline uses, which is the achievable ask for this size. With those settings, the table's 13x11/oppRam 6/headStart 2 row measures 37.5% win rate at 2.8 avg rounds -- squarely inside hard's 30-40% target band -- so the pressure-designer has a proven path to the target on this exact board rather than a guess. minPd is 8, roughly one and a half turns of the assumed playerRam 5, floored so a lucky rotation can't close the dive in one move on a board this large. parFlat is left at the cosmetic default of 3.
